messages:
Ellen (Finance): Urgent 1 MapleTech accounting reported two April invoices: one is zeroed for usage and VAT lines missing; the other is a full reissue. AP won't pay until reconciled.
billing-bot: Alert: invoice_generation_errors=2 customer_id=mapletech run=batch_apr_2026_04_01_0300 severity=high
Jules (Support): Ticket #6128 created: https://support.redwood.ai/t/6128 1 customer attached PDFs and says one file has invoice_id 2026-04-01014 (total $0) and the other 2026-04-01014-R (total $12,750).
Kevin (Billing Eng): Pulling DB: both records exist and reference batch_run=batch_apr_2026_04_01_0300. 2026-04-01014 line_items_count=2 total_cents=0; 2026-04-01014-R line_items_count=9 total_cents=1275000.
Marta (Payments): Capture present only on -R. No refunds processed.
Ellen (Finance): Priority: void the zero invoice, regenerate canonical PDF for -R with audit note, and create credit memo if accounting needs it. Customer wants corrected docs today.
Kevin (Billing Eng): Hypothesis: invoice_writer started, postprocess job (tax/promo) ran concurrently and triggered a retry which wrote a second invoice copy without marking the first as superseded. I'll add batch_run+invoice_key upsert as a fix. For now I'll void the zero invoice and regen PDF.
Renee (Product): I rolled back the promo experiment flag that may have been touching postprocess yesterday. Paused.
Jules (Support): Sending ETA to customer: "We will have corrected invoice and reconciliation note within 4 hours." They replied with "Please include VAT breakdown for our AP team."
Kevin (Billing Eng): Running void: `./ops/void_invoice --id 2026-04-01014 --actor kevin --reason "duplicate/incomplete generation"`
billing-bot: Job update: void_invoice completed invoice=2026-04-01014 actor=kevin status=success ts=1915001350
Kevin (Billing Eng): Regenerated PDF for 2026-04-01014-R, included audit line: "Canonical invoice retained; duplicate incomplete invoice 2026-04-01014 voided (batch batch_apr_2026_04_01_0300)." Uploaded to ticket.
Marta (Payments): Verified capture on -R only; no refunds necessary.
Ellen (Finance): Creating credit memo CM-2026-04-0213 to cover any accounting confusion; will apply to next statement. Adding VAT note in memo.
Kevin (Billing Eng): Running backfill to ensure ledger and line_items table match PDF: `python infra/billing/backfill_lines.py --invoice 2026-04-01014-R --source=batch_ledger`
billing-bot: Job update: backfill_lines completed invoice=2026-04-01014-R status=success ts=1915001445
Kevin (Billing Eng): PR opened for permanent fix: https://git.redwood.ai/r/billing/+/pr/378 1 enforces upsert on (batch_run, invoice_key) and adds a short exclusive lock during post-process. ETA review + deploy 24-48h.
Jules (Support): Sent corrected PDF and reconciliation CSV to MapleTech. Customer: "Thanks 1 please confirm when credit memo posts."
Ellen (Finance): Credit memo posted and linked to account. Note: "CM-2026-04-0213 applied to mapletech for duplicate invoice noise; VAT lines confirmed on canonical invoice." I'll update ticket and prepare RCA to share.
Kevin (Billing Eng): Backfill + ledger reconciliation done. Added internal note: "fixed missing VAT/usage lines for 2026-04-01014-R and voided duplicate zero invoice."
Ellen (Finance): Closing loop 1 please drop a short RCA here once PR merges so we can send to customers. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
